infographic.title: How a Control Valve Follows the Controller
infographic.alt: Infographic showing the signal path from controller output through the positioner and actuator to the valve trim
steps: The controller sends a 4 to 20 mA signal for the valve position it wants.
The current becomes a 3 to 15 psi air signal, and the positioner holds the stem where asked.
Air on the diaphragm or piston works against the spring to move the stem.
The plug moves against the seat ring and changes the size of the flow passage.
